title: ChatDiscord
description:
ChatDiscord is a PaperMC plugin for linking your Minecraft server chat to a Discord bot via secure HTTP requests.

This first stable release (v1.0) contains all the basic functionality required for simple communication between Discord and Minecraft.
body:
ChatDiscord is a PaperMC plugin for linking your Minecraft server chat to a Discord bot via secure HTTP requests.

This first stable release (v1.0) contains all the basic functionality required for simple communication between Discord and Minecraft.

You can invite the bot here [https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1379105737124610058&permissions=8&integration_type=0&scope=bot](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1379105737124610058&permissions=8&integration_type=0&scope=bot)
